smallestFirstSlice.whySmall: Two actual SDK cases expose the existing factory and the most concrete cross-surface discrepancy in one new test file. They need no API dispatcher, Studio server, browser, extra MCP tool, production registry or entitlement changes.
smallestFirstSlice.redPolicy: Capture the actual failing case and raw JSON/logs. Keep its expected legacy semantics. Review the root cause and exact ownership before any production repair; do not alter domain-wide truth or A4 behavior merely to turn this slice green.
smallestFirstSlice.successMeaning: Passing these two cases proves only this inventory and this legacy transparency path. It does not qualify all ten tools or P0-23 as a whole.
